Why it exists

Screenshots fade. Wallet assets do not.

Platform badges die with the vendor account. TalentTag issues a standard Solana asset you hold — so employers and clients verify with explorers they already trust.

  • Cryptographically verifiable

    Each badge is a cNFT on Solana. Ownership and metadata are checkable on-chain — not a screenshot.

  • Self-custodied

    The asset lives in your wallet. No platform can wall your credential behind a login you do not control.

  • One link, everywhere

    Résumé, proposal, DAO profile — the same proof URL travels with you.
